name: JoAi: Create Social Post

description.en: Create an Instagram feed post or carousel from team media. Leave the time empty to save a draft, or set a time to schedule it. Images must be JPEG, in the order they should appear.
description.de: Erstelle einen Instagram-Feed-Post oder ein Karussell aus Team-Medien. Ohne Zeit bleibt es ein Entwurf, mit Zeit wird es geplant. Bilder müssen JPEG sein, in der gewünschten Reihenfolge.

bot: Use this to draft or schedule an Instagram feed post. Upload images with media_upload first, then pass their IDs in order as a JSON array in media. Set scheduledAt in the team timezone when the user names a time. Omit scheduledAt to keep a draft. Only platform instagram is supported.

inputs.name: Images

description.en: Ordered team media IDs, e.g. ["abc","def"]. JPEG only. Upload with media_upload first.
description.de: Team-Medien-IDs in Reihenfolge, z.B. ["abc","def"]. Nur JPEG. Zuerst mit media_upload hochladen.

inputs.bot: JSON array of media IDs from media_upload, in carousel order.

description.en: When to publish. ISO time. Without a timezone, the team timezone is used. Omit to save a draft.
description.de: Wann veröffentlicht wird. ISO-Zeit. Ohne Zeitzone gilt die Team-Zeitzone. Weglassen speichert einen Entwurf.

description.en: Team slug. Defaults to the current team.
